name: Clever Distraction
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, mesmerist 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, M (a polished coin)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cast this spell by uttering a quick phrase and throwing a polished coin past the view of your opponent, taking them off guard for just a moment. A creature that fails a Will save is flat-footed until the beginning of its next turn.
